benefits.text: A standout new-generation mascara that gives lashes a super long, super thick, super curled look. It offers excellent hold, keeping the curl all day. With an outstanding smudge- and run-resistant formula, this mascara is made to stand up to different weather conditions. The smart brush helps coat each lash evenly and minimizes clumping, an ideal solution for short, weak lashes.

howToUse.text:
Apply directly to lashes from root to tip. 
Can be repeated to build volume as desired.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

positioning.text: Mascara that helps lashes look longer, thicker and curlier, suited to creating defined lashes for everyday makeup through to standout makeup.

sellingPoints.text: Helps lashes look longer, thicker and curlier; holds the curl all day according to brand materials; smudge- and run-resistant formula, minimizes clumping.

texture.text: Cream/gel mascara, with a brush that coats the lashes.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it actually lengthens/thickens lashes or nourishes lash growth. Use the “all day” claim exactly as in brand materials; avoid interpreting it as absolutely budge-proof.

finish.text: Defined black lashes / curled and full-looking / standout.
Defined brown lashes / curled and full-looking / standout.
